channel.title: SimplyHow
channel.description: SimplyHow publishes 80+ step-by-step how-to guides on technology, home & garden, cooking, DIY crafts and productivity. Clear instructions, real troubleshooting, no fluff.

item.title: How to Bake Cookies at Home (Crispy, Chewy, and Not Burnt)
item.description: Bake cookies that turn out the way you want - crisp edges, chewy centres, even baking, and the few recipe and oven mistakes that make cookies spread too much, bake unevenly, or come out hard.

item.title: How to Speed Up a Slow Laptop: 15 Fixes That Actually Work
item.description: Fix a slow laptop in 30 minutes with 15 tested steps - from startup cleanup and RAM upgrades to malware scans and power settings.

item.title: How to Back Up Your iPhone: iCloud, Mac and PC Methods
item.description: Back up your iPhone safely with step-by-step instructions for iCloud, Finder, iTunes and third-party tools - plus how to verify the backup works.

item.title: How to Transfer WhatsApp Chats to a New Phone (Android & iPhone)
item.description: Move all WhatsApp messages, photos and groups to a new phone - Android to Android, iPhone to iPhone, and cross-platform with the official tool.

item.title: How to Free Up Space on Your Android Phone (Without Losing Anything)
item.description: Reclaim gigabytes on Android with 12 safe steps - app caches, photo backups, downloads, messaging media and SD card tricks explained.

item.title: How to Set Up Dual Monitors on Windows and Mac
item.description: Connect and configure two monitors the right way - cables, detection, layout, scaling, alignment and the settings that make it feel seamless.

item.title: How to Recover Deleted Files from a Computer or Phone
item.description: Get deleted files back - from the recycle bin, cloud trash, backups and recovery software - with a clear action order that protects your data first.

item.title: How to Secure Your Home Wi-Fi Network in 10 Steps
item.description: Lock down your home Wi-Fi with 10 practical steps - strong passwords, WPA3, router updates, guest networks, DNS and device audits.

item.title: How to Make a Website from Scratch (Beginner's Step-by-Step Guide)
item.description: Build your first website step by step - domain, hosting, CMS or code, pages, SEO basics and launch checklist - with no prior experience needed.

item.title: How to Start a YouTube Channel from Zero (Complete Guide)
item.description: Launch a YouTube channel the right way - niche, name, equipment, your first 10 videos, filming, editing, thumbnails, SEO and growth basics.

item.title: How to Edit Videos on Your Phone (Beginner's Guide)
item.description: Edit great videos entirely on your phone - trimming, cuts, text, music, captions, color and export settings in CapCut, iMovie or VN.

item.title: How to Use Google Drive: Upload, Share, Organize and Offline Access
item.description: Master Google Drive - upload files, create documents, share with the right permissions, organize folders and work offline with confidence.

item.title: How to Factory Reset a Laptop (Windows & Mac, With Backups)
item.description: Factory reset your laptop safely - full backup checklist, Windows 10/11 and macOS reset steps, reinstall tips and what to do afterwards.

item.title: How to Connect a Wireless Printer (Wi-Fi, Windows, Mac, Phone)
item.description: Get any printer on Wi-Fi - WPS, manual network setup and step-by-step connection for Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android, plus print-fix troubleshooting.

item.title: How to Convert a PDF to Word (Online, Offline, Free Options)
item.description: Convert PDF files to Microsoft Word with step-by-step methods - online converters, Word itself, LibreOffice, and a clear warning about sensitive documents.

item.title: How to Improve Wi-Fi Signal Throughout Your House (Real Fixes)
item.description: Strengthen weak Wi-Fi everywhere - placement, channel and band choices, interference, mesh networks, extenders and powerline - with honest pros and cons.

item.title: How to Set Up Parental Controls (Phones, Screens, Apps and the Web)
item.description: Set up parental controls that respect kids' growing independence - screen time limits, app approvals, content filters and location - for phones and home Wi-Fi.

item.title: How to Declutter Your Digital Life (Phones, Computers, Files, Mail)
item.description: A clean, realistic digital declutter: trim apps and files, tame photos, empty storages before you reset, and a repeatable monthly rhythm that keeps clutter from coming back.

item.title: How to Plan Your Week (A Simple System That Actually Sticks)
item.description: Run a 20-minute weekly planning session: review the past week, capture everything, pick the three big things, slot tasks into your calendar, and build a rhythm that survives bad weeks.

item.title: How to Take Effective Notes (That You Will Actually Use)
item.description: Take notes that travel with you - capture the right things, structure them so you can find them later, and build a system small enough to sustain.

item.title: How to Overcome Procrastination (Without Willpower)
item.description: Stop procrastination by making tasks smaller, starting absurdly easy, designing your environment so starting is the path of least resistance, and working with yourself instead of against yourself.

item.title: How to Unclog a Drain (Sink, Shower, Toilet - Step by Step)
item.description: Clear a clogged drain yourself with the right order: hot water, manual removal, a plunger done correctly, and a drain snake - plus when a clog means a plumber is actually needed.

item.title: How to Remove Stains from Carpet (Coffee, Wine, Pet, Grease)
item.description: Remove common carpet stains safely - coffee, red wine, pet accidents, grease, ink and mud - with a clear stain-by-stain method, blotting technique and what never to do.

item.title: How to Start a Vegetable Garden (From Scratch, for Beginners)
item.description: Start a vegetable garden the practical way - pick a site, prepare the soil, choose hardy crops for your climate, and build the simple routine that keeps a garden producing.

item.title: How to Compost at Home (Bins, Piles, What to Add and Fix Problems)
item.description: Start composting at home with the right bin or pile, the right mix of greens and browns, simple turning and moisture habits, and fixes for smells, flies and slow piles.

item.title: How to Fix a Running Toilet (Flapper, Fill Valve, Overflow leaks)
item.description: Stop a running toilet by diagnosing the flapper, the fill valve, the overflow tube and other common causes - with step-by-step part replacements and a water-saving check.

item.title: How to Paint a Room Without Streaks (Prep, Tools, Technique)
item.description: Paint a room cleanly - prep the walls, pick the right tools, roll and cut in with the right technique, and avoid the streaks, lap marks and uneven finish that plague DIY painters.

item.title: How to Organize a Small Closet (Step by Step, Without Buying a Lot)
item.description: Make a small closet work better with a clear purge, simple zoning, smart use of vertical space, and cheap or no-cost fixes - plus habits that keep it from filling up again.

item.title: How to Deep Clean Your House (Room by Room, Without Burning Out)
item.description: Deep clean your home in a manageable way - a room-by-room approach, the right order, the spots most people miss, and a routine that keeps the deep clean from becoming a yearly overwhelm.

item.title: How to Get Rid of Ants in the House (Find the Nest, Kill the Line, Keep Them Out)
item.description: Get ants out of the house for good - find the trail and nest, use bait the right way, wipe out the pheromone path, seal entry points, and prevent the next wave.
